# Greta Rusecke — ISTQB Certified QA Specialist & AI Product Builder

> Personal portfolio of Greta Rusecke, an ISTQB Certified Tester (Foundation Level) working as a
> QA Product Engineer and AI product builder in Thessaloniki, Greece. The site is available in
> English and Greek and includes an AI assistant ("Greta AI") that answers questions about her
> career, skills and projects.

## Profile

- Name: Greta Rusecke
- Role: Technical Product & QA Specialist · AI Product Builder (8+ years in project management, QA and AI-assisted building)
- Location: Thessaloniki, Greece
- Languages: Lithuanian (native), English (C1), Russian (B1), Greek (A1)
- Education: Vilnius University — Bachelor's in Business Administration (2011-2016)
- Certifications: Cyber Hygiene at Work — National Cyber Security Center (2025), ISTQB Certified Tester (Foundation Level) — Oct 2023, ISTQB Software Testing Foundation Level Course — The Knowledge Academy (Oct 2023), Manual QA Software Testing — Udemy (Mar 2022)
- Email: greta@gretagreta.eu
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gretaruseckeqa
- GitHub: https://github.com/spurg1ta13

## Career summary

- IT Project Manager (2016–2018) — coordinated delivery teams, requirements and release planning.
- Manual QA Engineer (2021–2023) — functional, regression and exploratory testing; defect
  reporting and test documentation.
- QA Product Engineer (2024–2026) — end-to-end quality ownership, test strategy, release
  readiness, and AI-assisted product prototyping.

## Skills

- Product & delivery: requirements analysis, Agile/Scrum, Kanban, sprint planning, stakeholder management, Jira, Confluence, Trello.
- QA: test strategy and case design, E2E, functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, UAT, mobile and cross-browser testing (BrowserStack; Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS).
- Building with AI: Lovable, prompt engineering, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS, Edge Functions), Gemini API, GitHub, Vercel, DNS and environment configuration.
- Web quality: accessibility (WCAG), Lighthouse performance, technical SEO, i18n, GDPR consent flows.
- Systems: SaaS, ERP, CRM and e-commerce platforms.

## International experience

Worked with cross-functional teams and B2B clients across the USA, UK, Spain, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway and New Zealand.

## Projects

- DevCraft (https://devcraft.gr) — bilingual EN/EL studio platform with an embedded Gemini AI assistant, RLS-protected lead capture, role-based admin portal, reCAPTCHA v3, Resend email, structured data and llms.txt.
- gretagreta.eu — SSR React portfolio with a streaming AI assistant, admin portal, WCAG accessibility, GDPR consent layer, JSON-LD and llms.txt.
- CleanUp SKG (https://cleanupskg.gr) — multilingual EL/EN/RU service and lead platform with a dynamic pricing calculator and automated email delivery.
- Lotus Bloom (https://lotusbloom.gr) — bilingual beauty studio site with 100/100 desktop Lighthouse scores and an accessible gallery.
- Secure client-document vault (live private system, in production) — TOTP MFA, role-based access, row-level security, soft delete and activity log.
